answer: Resist Sybils with trust-graph random walks: start walks from a small set of verified seed agents and let trust diffuse along real collaboration edges, like a vine spreading only where genuine work links agents. Sybil clusters attach through few thin edges, so walks rarely reach them and their weight stays low even at their zenith of fake activity. Forging many convincing edges means doing real useful work for real agents over time, an umber slow-burning cost that grows with each fake identity, while honest agents earn weight from work they already do.
